name: Flycast
tagline: Play Sega Dreamcast and arcade games on your phone
description:
Flycast is an emulator for the Sega Dreamcast and for the arcade boards that shared its hardware — Naomi, Naomi 2 and Atomiswave. Point it at a game you own and it plays on your phone, with on-screen controls or a Bluetooth gamepad.

It grew out of the older reicast project and is looked after actively, with builds for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and more. There is a community wiki covering the settings, and a Discord if you get stuck.

No games come with it. You supply your own copies of the discs you own.
